verbs.verb: the build under test is the current build
verbs.observable: newest source mtime vs. the start of this run
verbs.threshold: every source file predates the run
verbs.note: No --source given. This run cannot prove it played current bytes.

verbs.verb: the page is visible, so rAF is running

verbs.observable: requestAnimationFrame callbacks in a 1 s window
verbs.note: The render loop is not running.

verbs.observable: uncaught page errors + console.error, minus the allowlist

verbs.verb: the simulation runs when the player does nothing (dead-sim detector)
verbs.input: no keys held for the whole window
verbs.observable: per-pixel luminance difference between consecutive frames, and between the first and last frame of the window
verbs.threshold: union changed-pixel ratio >= 0.001 AND >= 50% of consecutive frame pairs differ by >= 200 px
verbs.note: ZERO differing pixels across the whole frame over the idle window. The simulation is not running. This is the 2026-09-04 failure exactly.

verbs.verb: an unbound key changes nothing (negative control)
verbs.observable: player-band luminance centroid drift, and score

verbs.verb: the input layer receives key events
verbs.note: No __gate probe on this build. A dead input layer and an unimplemented verb are indistinguishable in this run; every input verb result below is pixel-only evidence.

verbs.input: sampled across every burst in this run
verbs.note: No probe; the cap is not observable from pixels.

verbs.verb: the harness released the controls and the build still responds
verbs.input: release everything, then hold Left for 500 ms
verbs.observable: held-key list, rAF count, player-band centroid drift
verbs.threshold: 0 keys held AND frames advancing AND the ship still moves
verbs.note: The run may have left the build in a state a human would find broken. Check before trusting the verdicts above.
